choose.when: SELECT execution.id, execution.id AS root_instance_id, execution.id AS instance_id, execution.trigger_id, execution.target_type, execution.target_id, execution.status, CASE WHEN execution.target_type = 'TASK' THEN task_snapshot.name WHEN execution.target_type = 'JOB' THEN job_snapshot.name ELSE NULL END AS name, execution.timeout_at AS observed_deadline, execution.create_time FROM ifj_instance execution LEFT JOIN ifj_task_definition task_snapshot ON task_snapshot.id = execution.task_definition_id LEFT JOIN ifj_job_definition job_snapshot ON job_snapshot.id = execution.definition_id WHERE execution.parent_instance_id IS NULL AND execution.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT') AND execution.timeout_at <= #{now} ORDER BY execution.timeout_at, execution.id

SELECT command_record.request_id AS id, command_record.trigger_id, command_record.root_instance_id, command_record.instance_id, command_record.status, command_record.command_type, command_record.expires_at AS observed_deadline, command_record.create_time FROM ifj_runtime_command command_record WHERE command_record.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND command_record.expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY command_record.expires_at, command_record.request_id
choose.otherwise:
SELECT work_item.trigger_id AS id, work_item.trigger_id, work_item.root_instance_id, trigger_record.target_type, trigger_record.target_id, CASE WHEN trigger_record.target_type = 'TASK' THEN task_snapshot.name WHEN trigger_record.target_type = 'JOB' THEN job_snapshot.name ELSE NULL END AS name, work_item.status, work_item.create_time,
work_item.lease_deadline AS observed_deadline
work_item.available_at AS observed_deadline
FROM ifj_trigger_work_item work_item JOIN ifj_trigger trigger_record ON trigger_record.id = work_item.trigger_id LEFT JOIN ifj_task_definition task_snapshot ON task_snapshot.id = trigger_record.task_definition_id LEFT JOIN ifj_job_definition job_snapshot ON job_snapshot.id = trigger_record.definition_id WHERE
work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.lease_deadline <= #{now}
work_item.status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND work_item.available_at <= #{queueCutoff} AND (work_item.expires_at IS NULL OR work_item.expires_at > #{now}) AND work_item.attempt_count < work_item.max_attempts
ORDER BY observed_deadline, work_item.trigger_id
